summary: A Godot 4.6 collectible card game: a main menu, a collection and deck manager, a turn and mana system, 665 card definitions with stats and effects (damage, heal, buff, debuff, life steal, bounce, destroy, draw and more), a card inspector, and an AI opponent that can chat through a local model. The royalty covers Dillan Copeland's Aetherium card content in this template (the 665 card definitions: names, stats, abilities); the game code is GPL-3.0 because it grew out of the open-source CCG Engine Template.
works: Opens and imports in Godot 4.6 with no script errors (checked with Godot 4.6 stable).
All 665 cards load from Resources/Cards/*.tres and the game boots to the main menu, with blank placeholder faces where the card art goes.

The turn and mana system, playing and attacking with cards, and the effect resolver come from the CCG Engine Template, extended with Aetherium's effects (damage, heal, buff, debuff, life steal, bounce, destroy, draw and more). Full matches were not played through for this release.
unfinished: Card art, music and the main menu art are not included: cards show a blank placeholder face and the menu plays no music until you add your own (see Not included).
About a dozen card names come from other games (RuneScape and Pokémon). Rename them before any commercial use.
Deck editing is partly built (the deck selection code calls its hand-off to the deck builder a stopgap).
Buffs do not wear off at the end of the turn yet.
The AI opponent's chat calls Ollama at localhost:11434 with qwen3:4b; using LM Studio needs a small change to Scripts/AI/OllamaClient.gd.
Balance, rules text and the AI's play have not been tuned or tested at length.
No online play and no export presets.
notIncluded: Card art (assets/card_textures/, 665 images, about 670 MB), kept for the Aetherium card set. Each card refers to res://assets/card_textures/<name>.png or .jpg: replace the placeholders with art of the same name, or point the cards at your own.
Music (assets/audio/music/): Dillan Copeland's original soundtrack is not part of the template.

Third-party art packs the game used, whose licenses do not allow passing the files on: Free Hologram Interface by Wenrexa (main menu buttons, free on itch.io), Lightning VFX by Frostwindz, and 16x16 effect and bullet sprites. Get your own copies from their authors.
The old JSON card database (data/), which the game no longer uses.
requirements: Optional: Ollama for the AI opponent's chat
openWith: Open Godot 4.6, choose Import, and pick project.godot in this folder. Godot rebuilds its import cache the first time (a minute or two). Run the project to reach the main menu.
